transmissions.title: A little more daylight
transmissions.line: TRANSMISSION 001 // The morning was early, but the radio was already awake.
transmissions.story: Someone left a window open on the far side of the night. The light crossed it anyway. This is a fictional transmission, not a recovered event.

transmissions.title: The greenhouse frequency
transmissions.line: TRANSMISSION 002 // The plants learned to hum before the radio learned to listen.
transmissions.story: At exactly noon, three blue flowers appeared where the speakers should have been. Nobody thought to ask if it was impossible. This is fiction.

transmissions.title: The cup remembers warmth
transmissions.line: TRANSMISSION 003 // A blue cup remained on the table. So did the invitation.
transmissions.story: Every road had a different name for home. The kettle just kept the water warm. Nothing in this transmission claims to document a real person or event.
